dedupe_keys.name: rectifhyd monthly united states hydropower generation

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory and Oak Ridge National Laboratory researchers publish RectifHyd monthly generation estimates for about 1,500 hydropower plants in the conterminous United States. The method disaggregates reported annual generation using reservoir releases or downstream streamflow, providing an alternative to EIA-923 monthly imputation. The paper release covers 2001–2020, while the linked version 1.3 extends through 2022 and improves release inputs, missing-data handling and flags. Zenodo supplies CSV and a README for free under CC BY 4.0. The estimates can constrain seasonal hydropower availability in grid-operation and capacity simulations, complementing data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower. A caveat is that most monthly values remain estimates tied to hydrological proxies, not direct generation observations. The newer version should not be silently substituted when reproducing the original paper. The repository also points to a distinct subsequent RectifHydPlus product, which is not included in this record. No generation rows were downloaded or recalculated.
